A Japanese Head Spa at Matrix is a spa day with purpose. Every ritual begins with a scalp analysis, then flows through double cleansing, gentle exfoliation, warm steam, a soothing waterfall rinse and slow, intentional scalp, neck and shoulder massage. You leave with a scalp that feels refreshed, hair that feels soft and a calm that stays with you long after your visit.
Matrix Precision Scalp Infusions™, crafted in house

What sets Matrix apart is what goes onto your scalp. We formulate our own organic Precision Scalp Infusions™ in our Salem studio, guided by scalp science, and your provider selects the one your scalp needs that day:
for barrier recovery and lasting moisture
for a clarifying reset from oil and product buildup
for scalp, jaw and neck tension relief
Love how your scalp feels? Take your infusion home in 3 mL vials ($14 to $20) or 2 oz bottles ($52 to $74) and keep your results going between visits.
Time to unwind in the Zen Lounge

Every Head Spa includes up to 30 minutes of complimentary Zen Lounge time after your session. Make your visit even more indulgent with a Luxury Hair Mask ($25), Deep Scalp Detox ($25), Advanced Infusion Upgrade ($25), Facial Massage Ritual ($45), Mini Facial ($65), grounding ($15), full-body red light therapy or a private infrared sauna session.
Your head spa near Kenosha County and Antioch

Guests visit our Salem studio from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Twin Lakes, Silver Lake, Kansasville, Union Grove, Burlington, Pleasant Prairie, Kenosha and Antioch, IL. Book your ritual online or text (262) 939-9325 and we will help you choose the perfect fit.
What is a Japanese Head Spa?

A Japanese Head Spa is a luxurious scalp and relaxation ritual. At Matrix it includes a scalp analysis, double cleansing, exfoliation, steam, waterfall therapy, a customized Precision Scalp Infusion™ and an extended scalp, neck and shoulder massage.
What makes the Matrix Head Spa different?

We craft our own organic Precision Scalp Infusions™ in house, based on scalp science, and match one to your scalp after analysis. Every Head Spa also includes up to 30 minutes of complimentary Zen Lounge time.
Which Head Spa should I book first?

The Matrix Signature Head Spa (60 minutes, $135) is our core luxury ritual and a beautiful first visit. Choose the Scalp Reset (45 minutes, $95) for focused maintenance, the Crown Ritual (90 minutes, $195) for an extended escape, or the BioTech Scalp Renewal (120 minutes, $265) for our most advanced experience with scalp imaging.
Can I book a Head Spa with short, thinning or no hair?
Yes. The Matrix Scalp Recovery Ritual (60 minutes, $135) is designed for shaved, thinning, short and low-hair scalps, with intensive scalp massage, pressure point therapy and a customized infusion.
Can I combine a Head Spa and a facial?
Yes. The Matrix Crown & Glow Ritual (120 minutes, $285) pairs our signature Head Spa with a customized mini facial. You can also add a Facial Massage Ritual or Mini Facial to any Head Spa.
How often should I book a Head Spa?
Many guests love a weekly or biweekly rhythm for ongoing scalp care. Our Scalp Reset Series (4 x 45 minutes, $340) and Signature Scalp Series (4 x 60 minutes, $500) make that easy.
Can I get my hair styled after my Head Spa?
Yes. Add an Express Blow Dry (from $35) or Luxury Blowout Styling (from $55), performed by a licensed cosmetologist when available.

Your appointment time is reserved just for you, so we ask for at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Cancellations made within 24 hours of your appointment, for any reason, and no-shows are charged the full price of the service plus an automatic 20% gratuity.
Do I need a card on file to book?

Yes. To secure your appointment, complete our intake form and credit card authorization form when you book. If you have a Matrix gift card on file instead, its remaining balance is applied toward any late-cancellation fee.
Where is Matrix located for Japanese Head Spa?

Matrix Massage & Bodywork is at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168, an easy drive from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Twin Lakes, Silver Lake, Kansasville, Union Grove, Burlington, Pleasant Prairie, Kenosha and Antioch, IL. Book online or text (262) 939-9325.
